Notes: Tab II event study t-stat 5 at 1 year.  Slightly different than MP.  Our construction is closest in the spirit of Ritter's Table II.  A few issues.  Main thing: sample should end in 1987, since the main table is for returns of stocks which IPO'd 1975-1984, and the table follows the stocks for 3 years (past 1984).  Also: using minimum of 3 months since IPO helps.
Detailed Definition: 1 if IPO in the past 6-36 months.  0 otherwise.  IPO dates are taken from Jay Ritter's IPO data available at: http://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/ritter/ipodata.htm.  Missing IPO dates imply IndIPO = 0
